title: Getting started with Ledgerly
text: Create your workspace, add your company details and send your first invoice in under five minutes.

title: Invoice templates
text: Choose a template, upload your logo and set default payment terms for every new invoice.

title: Exporting invoices
text: Export invoices to CSV or PDF from Invoices > Export. Filters such as date range and status apply to the export.

title: Importing customers
text: Import customers from a CSV or XLSX spreadsheet. Map columns to name, email, tax ID and billing address.

title: Multi-currency invoices
text: Each invoice can use its own currency. Change it from the invoice settings before the invoice is sent.

title: EU VAT and reverse charge
text: For B2B customers in another EU country, enable reverse charge so the invoice shows 0% VAT and the legal notice.

title: Recurring invoices
text: Create a recurring schedule (weekly, monthly, yearly). Ledgerly generates and sends each invoice automatically.

title: Automatic reminders
text: Reminders are sent 3 days before and 7 and 14 days after the due date. You can edit the schedule per customer.

title: Failed card payments
text: When a card payment fails the invoice stays open, the customer gets an email and we retry after 3 days.

title: Late payments
text: Invoices past due are marked overdue. Late fees and reminder cadence are configured in Settings > Payments.

title: Reports and analytics
text: Revenue, outstanding balance and aging reports. Every report can be downloaded as CSV.

title: Bank feeds
text: Connect a bank account to import transactions daily and match them to paid invoices.

title: Payment methods
text: Accept card, SEPA direct debit and bank transfer. Enable methods per invoice or globally.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Enable 2FA with an authenticator app. If you lose your device, use a recovery code to reset 2FA.

title: Account recovery
text: If you cannot sign in, an owner can reset your access, or support can verify your identity.

title: Roles and permissions
text: Invite team members as Owner, Admin, Accountant or Viewer. Viewers have read-only access.

title: Notifications
text: Choose which events send email or in-app notifications: payments, overdue invoices, comments.

title: Deleting your account
text: Owners can delete the workspace from Settings > Danger zone. Data is erased after 30 days.

title: Data retention
text: Invoices are kept for 10 years for tax purposes unless the workspace is deleted.

title: API limits
text: The REST API allows 100 requests per minute per token. Responses include rate limit headers.
